title: Weird Contraption: Final Goal
description: Adds some difficult recipes for the late game, so you can work towards a final goal. Originally developed for Weird Contraption 7.
body:
Adds a powerful late game engine that generates Stress Units. To craft it, you need ingredients from various different mods, so you have to play through some of the core mods to get this block. You also need to build a little structure around it for it to work.

There are 7 crafting items in total which - at the moment - are only used for crafting.

If you don't add all the optional dependencies, the engine won't be obtainable in survival, due to missing recipes (Though you can add your own recipes with a datapack or QubeJS).
